marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Monday.
marine.text:
Wind northwest 15 knots increasing to northwest 20 late this
evening then diminishing to northwest 15 late Monday morning. Wind diminishing
to light early Monday afternoon. Showers changing to flurries near midnight and ending
Monday morning. Fog patches forming Monday evening. Visibility as low as 1 mile
in flurries and 1 mile or less in fog patches. Temperatures near zero. <br/>
